From: Ariel Park <ariel.park@mediform.com>

Date: Mon, 3 Dec 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evaluation kickoff — environment handshake and activation plan

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to run a short evaluation (3 weeks) focused on latency and cost for our clinical summarization flow. To move quickly our infra team needs a concise list of what you need from us to spin up a POC environment. Specifically: org-level setup, service/API keys, IP allowlist, and VPC peering requirements.

Can you send a single-page activation sheet we can give to ops? Also confirm an approximate timeline — our goal is to be testing by Dec 18.

Ariel
CTO, Mediform Health

---
Attachments: mediform_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Ariel Park <ariel.park@mediform.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Dec 2028 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff — environment handshake and activation plan

Ariel — thanks, and happy to own the activation sheet. I attached a short "activation checklist" (redwood_eval_handshake_v1.xlsx) and sketched a lightweight network diagram. High-level ask below so your ops engineers can copy/paste into a ticket: 

1) Redwood org + admin user
   - Please create an org in our console and add a named org admin (email) for Mediform. We’ll send an invite; admin is used for billing/rollouts and to mint API keys.

2) API credentials (for eval)
   - We'll generate a short-lived evaluation API key under the org. For production you’ll use a service account pattern; for eval we recommend a 30-day key.

3) IP allowlist
   - Add these egress CIDRs to your firewall allowlist so callbacks (webhooks/streams) reach your cluster: 34.200.18.0/24, 34.200.19.0/24. If you prefer, we can use a static NAT IP; tell us which project.

4) VPC peering (optional but recommended for low-latency)
   - If you want dedicated routing we’ll request a VPC peering from our side. We need: your GCP project ID (or AWS account + VPC ID), preferred peering window, and a contact for network validation.

Suggested timeline (3-week evaluation):
Week 0 (this week): org invite, admin add, API key issuance, IP allowlist entry.
Week 1: basic smoke tests + sample traffic (we’ll provide a cURL test harness).
Week 2: run scale tests and measure tail latency; iterate batching/quantization.
Week 3: final report and close discussion.

Next steps: if you confirm the org admin and network contact I’ll loop in Karthik (networking) and Grace (eng ops) to pick exact peering windows and provide the DocuSign link for the eval agreement.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_eval_handshake_v1.xlsx, mediform_network_sketch.png

Karthik / Grace — looping you in to coordinate the peering window and the short-lived key issuance. Ariel is aiming for testing by Dec 18. Action items: 

- Karthik: can you confirm if 12/12–12/14 is free for a peering cutover? If Mediform prefers non-peered (NAT) approach we can still provide static egress IPs; list will be in the spreadsheet.
- Grace: please prepare a one-page runbook for the eval key rotation and token expiry (30-day key). Also confirm that we can enable prefix caching for their workload (helps cost).

I pasted the current checklist in the attached sheet. I’ll start a short kickoff call thread if we need day/time.

Thanks — Soojin
